verdict.rationale: Controlling context memory allocation across concurrent model instances is a fair question for a local LLM inference engine, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents context or KV-cache sizing, parallel slots, or memory partitioning across instances. The available items cover adjacent topics only: weight quantization, CPU+GPU hybrid offload, and mmap RAM reduction.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can control how context memory is allocated when running multiple model instances concurrently
